title: Specifies the automatically generated grid row height
goal: Distinguish between explicit rows of grid-template-rows and implicit rows of grid-auto-rows.
summary: has two columns on the duty board. The first line displays the long description, and each additional line generates a new line for each additional item.
tasks: retains the first row’s height of 64px.
Use grid-auto-rows to set subsequent automatic rows to 40px, maintaining two columns and spacing.

example.note: After the explicit rows are filled, subsequent items will be arranged into implicit rows, the size of which is determined by grid-auto-rows.

hint: The height of the first row has been given, only the properties to control the automatic row are added.
